item.title: Statistical Innovation and Data Science for Public Service Evaluation in the Age of AI
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites research on the application of statistical methods and data science techniques to evaluate public services in an era increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence. The collection seeks to explore how advanced analytical approaches can improve the understanding and assessment of public sector performance and outcomes.

Appel publié par Socio-Economic Planning Sciences. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Statistical innovation
  • Data science
  • Public service evaluation
  • Artificial intelligence
